lambda_variant: none: VPC foundation in its own Terraform root, consumed by ecs-web and alb-ec2 through SSM parameters

lifecycle.reason: A VPC has no runtime. The module version (terraform-aws-modules/vpc 6.7.3) is pinned and is checked at template release.

dependencies.name: terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws
dependencies.delivery: Terraform registry module, published 2026-09-18, requires hashicorp/aws >= 6.28

contract.lifecycle: own Terraform root and state; applied rarely; services never own it
contract.publishes: /landform/network/<project>-<environment>/{vpc-id, public-subnet-ids, private-subnet-ids (nat_mode single or per-az), nat-mode}
contract.nat: none: public subnets only, no hourly cost; single: one NAT gateway; per-az: one per zone
contract.consumers: ecs-web and alb-ec2 read network_name at plan time; subnet_ids still wins when given

instrumentation.logging: VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, 10-minute aggregation

review: pending: promote status to supported after a person reviews the sandbox evidence
